walls.note: Long front of the monument: RoMaVo photographs 1 and 3 (CC0) and Ceescamel 2025 B, F (CC0) in artifacts/landmark-refs/slavernijmonument/.

items.where: huge bronze figure rising from the platform and bending over, its long head pointing like a beak
items.how: builder: three tapered limbs for the body, a tapered cone for the beak, an ellipsoid skull and one hanging arm; surface texture omitted

items.where: second tall bronze figure by a post with arms raised and hair streaming
items.how: builder: post, two raised arms and a leaning body with a sphere head

items.where: a chain of about twelve slim bronze walkers leaning against the pull, bound by ropes
items.how: builder: twelve three-limb figures with sphere heads in two ranks and two thin rope bars; individual faces and poses are not distinct

items.where: low dark-grey concrete platform carrying the groups, on a round paved apron
items.how: builder: a box 11 x 4.5 x 0.75 m on a 12.4 m disc

walls.note: Rear side seen in the Ceescamel and Arthena photographs: the same platform edge, the figures from behind.

sources.name: RoMaVo, Erwin de Vries - Nationaal Monument Slavernijverleden (Commons)
